+from rich.segment import Segment
+from rich.cells import cell_len
+
+def test_split():
+    test_cases = [
+        ("A", 0),
+        ("A", 1),
+        ("AA", 0),
+        ("AA", 1),
+        ("AA", 2),
+        ("wide", 0), # wide is 4 chars, all 1 cell
+        ("wide", 1),
+        ("wide", 2),
+        ("wide", 3),
+        ("wide", 4),
+        ("\u3042", 0), # 1 char, 2 cells
+        ("\u3042", 1), # 1 char, 2 cells
+        ("\u3042", 2), # 1 char, 2 cells
+        ("A\u3042", 0), # 1 + 2 = 3 cells
+        ("A\u3042", 1), # 1 + 2 = 3 cells
+        ("A\u3042", 2), # 1 + 2 = 3 cells
+        ("A\u3042", 3), # 1 + 2 = 3 cells
+        ("\u3042A", 0), # 2 + 1 = 3 cells
+        ("\u3042A", 1), # 2 + 1 = 3 cells
+        ("\u3042A", 2), # 2 + 1 = 3 cells
+        ("\u3042A", 3), # 2 + 1 = 3 cells
+        ("\u3042\u3042", 0), # 2 + 2 = 4 cells
+        ("\u3042\u3042", 1), # 2 + 2 = 4 cells
+        ("\u3042\u3042", 2), # 2 + 2 = 4 cells
+        ("\u3042\u3042", 3), # 2 + 2 = 4 cells
+        ("\u3042\u3042", 4), # 2 + 2 = 4 cells
+        ("A\u200B B", 0), # 1 + 0 + 1 + 1 = 3 cells
+        ("A\u200B B", 1),
+        ("A\u200B B", 2),
+        ("A\u200B B", 3),
+        ("\u200B A", 0), # 0 + 1 = 1 cell
+        ("\u200B A", 1),
+    ]
+
+    for text, cut in test_cases:
+        seg = Segment(text)
+        before, after = seg.split_cells(cut)
+        
+        len_before = cell_len(before.text)
+        len_after = cell_len(after.text)
+        
+        print(f"Text: {text!r}, Cut: {cut}, Before: {before.text!r} (len {len_before}), After: {after.text!r} (len {len_after}), Total: {len_before + len_after}")
+        
+        original_len = cell_len(text)
+        if len_before + len_after != original_len:
+            print(f"FAILURE: Length mismatch! {len_before + len_after} != {original_len}")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    test_split()
